description: Source code for managing promisor remotes in a Git-like version control system, including functions for fetching objects, managing remote configurations, and handling promisor remote info exchange.

methods.name: fetch_objects
methods.description: Fetches objects from a promisor remote for a given repository.

methods.name: promisor_remote_new
methods.description: Creates a new promisor remote and adds it to the configuration.

methods.name: promisor_remote_lookup
methods.description: Looks up a promisor remote by name in the configuration.

methods.name: promisor_remote_move_to_tail
methods.description: Moves a promisor remote to the tail of the list in configuration.

methods.name: promisor_remote_config
methods.description: Configures promisor remotes based on git configuration variables.

methods.name: promisor_remote_init
methods.description: Initializes promisor remote configuration for a repository.

methods.name: promisor_remote_clear
methods.description: Clears all promisor remotes from configuration.

methods.name: repo_promisor_remote_reinit
methods.description: Reinitializes promisor remotes for a repository.

methods.name: repo_promisor_remote_find
methods.description: Finds a promisor remote by name or returns all.

methods.name: repo_has_promisor_remote
methods.description: Checks if the repository has any promisor remote.

methods.name: repo_has_accepted_promisor_remote
methods.description: Checks if the repository has any accepted promisor remote.

methods.name: remove_fetched_oids
methods.description: Removes already fetched object IDs from the list.

methods.name: promisor_remote_get_direct
methods.description: Fetches specific objects directly from promisor remotes.

methods.name: allow_unsanitized
methods.description: Checks if a character is allowed in URL encoding.

methods.name: promisor_remote_info
methods.description: Generates a string describing promisor remotes for advertisement.

methods.name: promisor_remote_reply
methods.description: Generates a reply string with accepted promisor remotes.

methods.name: mark_promisor_remotes_as_accepted
methods.description: Marks specified promisor remotes as accepted based on input string.
